name: Sketch and Patch
aliases: Sketch and Patch: Efficient 3D Gaussian Representation for Man-Made Scenes
definition: A method to create a structure-aware 3D Gaussian representation by separating Gaussians into 'Sketch Gaussians' (along edges/contours) and 'Patch Gaussians' (smooth regions). Sketch Gaussians are encoded via polynomial regression for compactness, while Patch Gaussians are pruned and retrained.
summary: Sketch and Patch is a hybrid 3D Gaussian representation that separates Gaussians into Sketch and Patch roles to reduce storage redundancy in man-made scenes.
